The Founder's Story

I understand hearing loss from the inside — not a textbook.

I'm a hearing-impaired father of two. I've sat in audiology waiting rooms. I've watched my family navigate hearing healthcare. I've felt the anxiety patients feel when they don't understand their diagnosis.

That's why I built Quantum Spark. Not as a marketer who learned audiology — but as someone who lives it and learned how to tell that story in a way that moves patients to book.

No generic agency can buy that authenticity. And your patients can feel the difference the moment they see your content.

How It Works

Five steps. You spend 30 minutes a month.
We do the rest.

Our AI workflow produces a full month of clinic content in hours, not weeks. Here's exactly what happens.

01
30-Minute Onboarding Call

We record your voice, your patient stories, and your practice philosophy. This becomes your living brand brief — every piece of content we ever produce is built from it. One call. Revisited quarterly.

02
Monthly Content Strategy

Using your brand brief, real audiology trends (new hearing aid releases, tinnitus awareness campaigns, OTC regulatory changes), and your local market signals — we build a full monthly content calendar mapped to the patient journey: awareness → consideration → trust → booking.

03
AI Content Production

We produce every social post, video script, graphic, and email in your voice. Captions. Patient education carousels. Short-form video scripts. Email sequences. All generated and quality-reviewed by us — not outsourced, not templated.

04
You Review in One Sitting

We deliver your full monthly batch to a simple shared folder. You review, leave any notes, we revise. Most practices spend under 20 minutes. Our onboarding process is designed to minimize revisions from month one — we aim to nail it first time.

05
Schedule, Publish, Report

We schedule everything across your platforms. At month's end, you get a plain-English performance report: what worked, what's trending in your market, what we're testing next month. Then we invoice and do it all again.

FAQ

Questions every practice owner asks.

Most marketing agencies are generalists — or at best, healthcare generalists. They learn about audiology from a brochure. We understand hearing loss from lived experience: our founder is hearing-impaired with a hearing-impaired family member. That insider knowledge shows in every piece of content we produce. Patients respond to authentic voices, not clinical templates.
Yes — and this is the core of what we do. Our onboarding process extracts your brand voice, philosophy, patient stories, and local community hooks. Every piece of content is written in your voice using that brief. We don't use templates. We don't repurpose generic audiology content. Your content sounds like you, because it's built from you.
Less than 30 minutes per month after your initial onboarding call. We deliver your monthly content batch, you review it, leave quick notes if needed, and approve. Most practices make zero or one change to the whole batch. The initial onboarding call is 30 minutes total.
We focus on where your patients actually are: Facebook (primary for the 55+ demographic), Instagram (reaching adult children who refer), and LinkedIn (professional referral networks). We also handle Google Business Profile optimization and patient email. We recommend starting with 2–3 platforms and expanding as results build.
Month-to-month only. We don't lock clients in. If you're not seeing value, you shouldn't be paying. We do ask for a 50% deposit on month one to cover onboarding work.
Fast. After your free audit call, if we decide to move forward, we can have your first content batch ready within 7–10 business days of your onboarding call. No long setup process.
Yes — we offer AI workflow consulting as an add-on service, helping practices implement AI for clinical documentation, patient communication, and scheduling automation. Typically added after 2–3 months of content work. Ask about it in your audit call.
